filename.description: Name of the file as transferred, ending with .gz when compressed

source_filename.description: Name of the ingested file, before any compression

source_path.description: Local path of the file actually transferred

size_bytes.description: Size of the transferred file in bytes

compressed.description: True when the file was gzipped before transfer

backup_type.description: Backup sink: BackupS3, BackupLocal or BackupSFTP

destination.description: S3 bucket, local root directory or SFTP host

destination_path.description: Full path of the file on the destination

model_name.description: Name of the model class of the ingested file

duration.description: Transfer duration in seconds, spanning every attempt including the waits between them

attempts.description: Number of transfer attempts made for this destination; 1 when it succeeded first time

status.description: OK, KO, REPLACED, SKIPPED or REQUESTED

error_type.description: Exception class name when status is KO

details.description: Error message when status is KO

origin.description: Who wrote the report: collector or archive

backup_name.description: Name of the backup the file was written to

operation_id.description: Identifier of the maas-operation that requested the transfer, when there is one

product_id.description: Identifier of the product in the catalogue

product_name.description: Name of the product in the catalogue

catalogue_checksum.description: The catalogue's checksum for the product
